body:
BIG_O's GFD phone app now relays real say text onto IDUNA's existing cross-server chat bus (POST/GET /api/v1/chat/messages), joining GFD<->EINHORN_SURVIVAL's existing bridge as a third participant. New bigo_gfd_bridge.h (poller+send pthreads, JSON-array walker, ring buffer). IDUNA: new bigo_server/big_o source+channel, new BIGO-SERVER M2M agent provisioned + live-restarted. Real end-to-end verification against the actual running IDUNA (real auth, real historical multi-source chat correctly relayed, self-echo skipped). Unit tests + bazel 33/33 + clean builds. IDUNA 718999e+de55624, BIG_O 8bf93d5.

⚓ ☃
title: Real GFD integration -- BIG_O joins the live cross-server chat bridge (NORTHSTAR §27)
